title: M5GFX #433: stop the build when the LP I2C FIFO depth is unknown (code-level review)

execution.environment: macOS arm64; Apple clang 21.0.0; ESP-IDF headers fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com for v5.4.1..v6.1.1, master and v6.3-dev; no local ESP-IDF 6.x toolchain and Docker cannot create containers

checks.detail: 1 file, +3/-0 in src/lgfx/v1/platforms/esp32/common.inl (one #elif plus #error inside getFifoLen); head 99eb30e on develop e88846e (the merge of #432), single commit, MERGEABLE, patch applies cleanly

112-row survey over 14 refs x 8 chips: every tag that defines SOC_LP_I2C_NUM (C5/C6/P4 in 5.4.1-5.5.4, H4 in 5.5.1-5.5.4, C5/C6/P4/S31 in 6.0-6.1.1/master/6.3-dev) also defines a depth macro (SOC_LP_I2C_FIFO_LEN 16 or I2C_LL_LP_FIFO_LEN 16); no ref has the port count without a depth macro, so the new branch is unreachable for released SDKs

LGFX_LP_I2C_NUM is derived at common.inl:121-130 and is >0 only when SOC_LP_I2C_NUM>0, driver/i2c_master.h exists and ESP-IDF>=5.4, so chips without an LP port (ESP32/C2/C3/S2/S3/C61/H4-6.x) never enter the branch; getFifoLen is called only at common.inl:2760 and :2802

extracted isLpPort()/getFifoLen() from base and head compiled with -Wall -Wextra -Werror for 7 released configurations (6.x C6/P4/C2/ESP32, 5.x C6/P4/ESP32): identical values on base and head (HP 32, LP 16, P4 LP at port 2, C2 16); no new warnings

synthetic LP-port config without a depth macro: base builds and returns HP depth 32 (the silent fallback), head stops the build in both variants (SOC_I2C_FIFO_LEN only, I2C_LL_FIFO_LEN only) with the message 'LP I2C FIFO depth is unknown: neither SOC_LP_I2C_FIFO_LEN nor I2C_LL_LP_FIFO_LEN is defined'

IDFBuild.yml 6.x jobs are esp32/esp32s3 at 6.0.2 only (no LP port); C5 5.5.2, C6 5.4.3, P4 5.4.3, C61 5.5.2 are all 5.x; ArduinoBuild.yml tops out at core 3.3.0 (ESP-IDF 5.5.0). The new #elif and the #error are preprocessed out in every CI job, so the 20 passing checks do not compile this hunk. Non-blocking: add esp32c6 at 6.0.2.

the guard covers a renamed depth macro only; if a future SDK drops SOC_LP_I2C_NUM (H4 does between 5.5.x and 6.0), LGFX_LP_I2C_NUM silently becomes 0 and the LP port disappears with no build error. Out of scope for this PR, recorded so the protection is not overstated.
no ESP32-C5 / C6 / P4 hardware here; the author's builds and the #432 on-device data were not reproduced

structural: the change only decides whether the translation unit compiles, so every configuration that builds produces code identical to base and no device model can show a difference; the only observable is build success/failure

not run locally: Docker cannot create containers on this host (write /var/lib/desktop-containerd/.../meta.db: read-only file system) and no local ESP-IDF 6.x toolchain; relies on the author's ESP32-P4 / IDF 6.1 build plus the header survey
no released SDK reaches the #error; only synthetic macro-less builds exercise it

notes: PR left OPEN; one English comment posted (https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/pull/433#issuecomment-6981823847); no close, no push to the upstream repository, no code changes to m5stack/M5GFX.
The guard implements the #error suggestion made while reviewing #432, so the review checks reachability against real headers rather than re-arguing the design.
v5.4.0 and v5.5.0 are not existing tags (404), hence 5.4.1 as the lower bound of the 5.4 line.
